description.value: Langley Sushi Mori is a Japanese fusion restaurant located in a Langley shopping centre, part of a small chain that opened its first location in Coquitlam in 2010. The kitchen emphasizes fresh ingredients and an exclusive house-made sauce crafted from fruits and vegetables, served in a vintage interior featuring natural stone and wood elements meant to evoke a forest setting. Touring cyclists can stop in for dine-in or takeout, with third-party delivery also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Japanese fusion restaurant at #160-19653 Willowbrook Dr, Langley, corroborating the OSM address and primary phone number. The website explicitly states 'Dine In & Take Out,' supporting the OSM takeaway=yes tag. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM lists a single phone number (+1-604-510-1538); website lists a second number (604-510-8805) not present in OSM.
OSM opening hours (Su-We 11:30-22:30; Th-Sa 11:30-23:00) differ from the website, which states a uniform 11:30am-10:00pm daily close — OSM may be outdated.
